items.text: Monet is in the training data. Greg Rutkowski became Midjourney's #1 referenced artist without ever consenting. 78 million artworks have been opted out via Have I Been Trained. The AI art consent crisis, explained.

Goldman Sachs said AI wouldn't lift the broader economy until 2027. Harvard's Jason Furman showed the data processing sector was already generating 92% of US GDP growth. Both facts are true — and together they tell a story most headlines missed.

Forrester predicts 50% of AI layoffs reversed by 2027. The companies that fired their teams are about to need them back. That's a window — for the people who spent the transition building the skills that matter.
Enterprise AI costs $400/month per seat. You can replicate most of it for under $50 — if you know which tools to combine and how BYOK changes the economics. Here's the exact stack.
MIT found only 5% of 300 AI implementations showed real profit impact. Here's where AI genuinely saves time for small businesses — and where you're paying for the promise, not the product.
MIT found 60% of companies evaluate AI tools — but only 5% deploy them with real results. The failure usually wasn't the tool. It was the five questions nobody asked before signing up.

You don't need a developer, six subscriptions, or six months of experimentation. Here's the AI setup that most people should start with — free, paid, and BYOK — to go from zero to productive in one afternoon.
AI is trained to agree with you. That's not a feature — it's an optimization function. Here are three techniques that force it to push back and actually sharpen your decisions.
Klarna cut 40% of its workforce and deployed a chatbot to replace 700 customer service agents. The chatbot failed on complex issues. Now Forrester predicts 50% of AI layoffs will be reversed by 2027.
Companies cited 55,000 US layoffs as AI efficiency gains in 2025. MIT then studied 300 actual implementations. Only 5% showed real profit impact. Here's what the 5% had in common.

Researchers studied 54,000 patients and found worsened delusions after AI chatbot use. In the boardroom, the same dynamic is playing out at trillion-dollar scale — and most people inside it don't know they're in it.

AI is finally capable enough to help. Somehow it became one more thing to manage. The anticipation gap — why agents made us stressed project managers, and what the breakthrough product has to look like.
Goldman Sachs projects $7.6T in AI infrastructure by 2031. Ed Zitron spent a week hunting for the enterprise customers. He found almost no one.
BBC investigation: 414 documented cases of AI-induced delusion. Adam armed himself at 3am. A neurologist ended up in a psychiatric ward. What happened — and is it getting better?
80 million jobs will be lost. 170 million will be created. The WEF map of who gets hurt, what roles are born, and how to cross the distance.
Cursor cut tool errors 10x by fixing the harness, not the model. SWE-Bench swings 10 points from scaffold alone — you have been blaming the wrong thing.
